**④ ef — HANDOFF124 ĐÓNG (ACK sau tự kiểm):** verify exact-head SUCCESS @ `98e5ba966` · artifact `b5a9023b…` 7107B pin ✓ · 7 BL→4 factory (ctor→vptr→size đủ) · 6 calls 181/200/196/171/181/171 · 930 DWORDs bit-equal · boundary sink assert. **R2 CLAIM (`6423892767`) ACCEPTED** — review-118 chạy (deliver 125 + `review:` comment).
